name: Talkbox wobble
desc: Vowel-morphing dubstep wobble in G minor: retriggered sawtooth 8ths run through a cycling o-a-e-i vowel filter on top of an lpf LFO, so the bass literally talks. Full rides an 8-step riff; peak doubles notes with ply and superimposes an octave-up shadow. Caspa/Rusko talk-wub school.

code.full: n("<0 0 7 0 0 5 7 3>*8").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("sawtooth").clip(.92).vowel("<o a e i o a>").lpf(sine.range(160, ${cut}).fast(${wob})).lpq(7).attack(.005).decay(.22).sustain(.5).release(.07).shape(.45).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 [1 0] 1>").gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: n("<0 0 7 0 0 5 7 3>*8").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("sawtooth").ply("<1 1 2 1>").clip(.92).vowel("<o a e i o a>*2").lpf(sine.range(200, ${cut}).fast(${wob})).lpq(9).attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.06).shape(.5).superimpose(x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
